string-array.name: help_text
string-array.item: Welcome to the Numeri puzzle game.
Your goal is to draw a single loop line with no loose ends. The line must circumvent all the numbers in order to make them valid.
When the number of line segments around a cell matches the displayed value, the cell is considered valid.
Tap a cell, or drag across several, to flip their sides.
Use \'>\' to show the solution, or to create a new puzzle. Use \'<\' to clear the puzzle.
Placing the phone face down reveals the missing numbers in the grid to help you solve it.
